al-farabi-kazakh-national-university.about:
Al-Farabi Kazakh National University (KazNU), founded in 1934, has a large campus in Almaty and is Kazakhstan's largest university. It covers natural sciences, mathematics, international relations, journalism, law, economics, philology and biotechnology, and hosts many students from Central Asia and beyond.

International students apply directly to the university, with programmes available in Kazakh, Russian and English; fees and living costs are low compared with Europe.
al-farabi-kazakh-national-university.aid_intl: Kazakh government grants and university scholarships for some international students.
al-farabi-kazakh-national-university.tests: No SAT/ACT. Kazakh applicants use the national UNT; international applicants are admitted through the university's own procedure (interview/entrance testing). Programmes are taught in Kazakh, Russian and, increasingly, English.
al-farabi-kazakh-national-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Secondary school diploma with recognition in Kazakhstan
Proof of proficiency in the programme language

complutense-university-of-madrid.about:
The Complutense University traces its roots to 1293 and today has its main Ciudad Universitaria campus in Madrid and the Somosaguas campus. It is strong in medicine, law, political science and sociology, psychology, fine arts, journalism and veterinary medicine.

International applicants obtain Spanish university-access accreditation (often through UNEDasiss) and apply via Madrid's pre-enrolment; public fees are moderate.
complutense-university-of-madrid.aid_intl: Spanish government and Madrid regional grants (mainly for residents) and UCM scholarships.
complutense-university-of-madrid.tests: No SAT/ACT. International applicants need Spanish university-access recognition (e.g. UNEDasiss accreditation, with PCE specific-competence exams to raise the admission grade) and then pre-enrol for each degree. Teaching is mainly in Spanish.
complutense-university-of-madrid.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Secondary school diploma with recognition/homologation or UNEDasiss accreditation
Spanish university-entrance route (UNEDasiss accreditation / PCE specific-competence exams) where required
Proof of funds for the Spanish student visa

king-abdulaziz-university-kau.about:
King Abdulaziz University was founded in 1967 in Jeddah and has separate campuses for male and female students plus branches across the Makkah region. It is strong in engineering, medicine, marine sciences, earth sciences and business, with high research output.

International undergraduates usually join through Saudi government scholarship programmes, which typically cover tuition and living support; programme language (Arabic or English) varies by faculty.
king-abdulaziz-university-kau.aid_intl: Scholarships for international students offered through Saudi government programmes (e.g. Study in Saudi), which can cover tuition, housing and a stipend.
king-abdulaziz-university-kau.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; Saudi applicants use national Qudurat/Tahsili tests. International scholarship applicants are selected on academic records and programme requirements. Many science, medicine and engineering programmes use English; others teach in Arabic.
king-abdulaziz-university-kau.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: English or Arabic proficiency depending on the programme
Scholarship application (Study in Saudi) for international students

lomonosov-moscow-state-university.about:
Lomonosov Moscow State University (MSU) occupies the iconic Main Building on the Sparrow Hills and has more than 40 faculties. It is renowned for mechanics and mathematics, physics, chemistry, computational mathematics and cybernetics, and also teaches economics, law, journalism and languages.

Foreign citizens apply directly with school documents and sit MSU's entrance tests, or are nominated via the Russian government quota; Russian proficiency is essential, and the preparatory faculty offers a foundation year. Applicants should check current visa and banking conditions for studying in Russia.
lomonosov-moscow-state-university.aid_intl: Russian government quota places (tuition-free) for selected foreign applicants; otherwise fee-paying contracts.
lomonosov-moscow-state-university.tests: No SAT/ACT. Teaching is in Russian: foreign applicants take MSU's entrance examinations (or apply via the government quota) and need Russian proficiency; a preparatory faculty offers a Russian-language foundation year.
lomonosov-moscow-state-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Secondary school transcripts (legalised, translated into Russian)
Secondary school diploma with recognition in Russia

pontificia-universidad-catolica-de-chile.about:
Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, founded in 1888, has several campuses in Santiago (San Joaquín, Casa Central, Lo Contador, Oriente) and one in Villarrica. It is particularly strong in engineering, economics and business, medicine, law, architecture and communications.

Most students enter through Chile's national PAES exam, while graduates of foreign secondary schools apply via special admission with their school records and international qualifications. Teaching is in Spanish.
pontificia-universidad-catolica-de-chile.aid_intl: Merit and need-based scholarships mainly for students admitted through the national system; limited options for foreign applicants.
pontificia-universidad-catolica-de-chile.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; Chilean applicants use the national PAES test, while foreign secondary-school graduates use UC's special admission route (school record, international exams such as IB, and possibly interviews). Teaching is in Spanish.
pontificia-universidad-catolica-de-chile.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

universidad-de-chile.about:
Founded in 1842, Universidad de Chile has educated many Chilean presidents and two Nobel laureates in literature. Its campuses across Santiago host strong faculties of medicine, law, physical and mathematical sciences (engineering), sciences, economics and the arts.

Most students enter through the national PAES; foreign graduates can apply via special admission. All teaching is in Spanish.
universidad-de-chile.aid_intl: Chilean gratuidad and scholarships mainly for residents; limited options for foreign applicants.
universidad-de-chile.tests: No SAT/ACT. Chilean students enter via the national PAES exam; foreign secondary-school graduates can use special admission routes. Teaching is in Spanish.
universidad-de-chile.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

universidad-nacional-autonoma-de-mexico-.about:
UNAM, with roots in 1551 and refounded in 1910, enrols hundreds of thousands of students; its Ciudad Universitaria campus is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It covers almost every discipline and is especially influential in the humanities, social sciences, medicine, engineering, architecture and the sciences.

Applicants outside UNAM's own high-school system sit a competitive admission exam; foreign students must revalidate their secondary studies and study in Spanish. Tuition is nominal.
universidad-nacional-autonoma-de-mexico-.aid_intl: Nominal tuition; UNAM scholarships are mainly for enrolled students.
universidad-nacional-autonoma-de-mexico-.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's entry for applicants from outside the UNAM high-school system is through UNAM's competitive admission exam; foreign certificates need revalidation. Teaching is in Spanish.
universidad-nacional-autonoma-de-mexico-.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

universidade-de-sao-paulo-br.about:
The University of São Paulo, founded in 1934, has campuses in São Paulo city and across the state (São Carlos, Ribeirão Preto, Piracicaba and others). It leads Latin America in research output and is strong in medicine, engineering (Poli-USP), law, agricultural sciences (ESALQ), economics and the arts.

As a public university it charges no tuition. Admission is highly competitive via FUVEST or ENEM/SISU, and international students must be ready to study in Portuguese.
universidade-de-sao-paulo-br.aid_intl: Tuition-free public university; student-support programmes (housing, meals) are available on a means-tested basis.
universidade-de-sao-paulo-br.tests: No SAT/ACT. Undergraduate entry is mainly through the FUVEST vestibular exam or ENEM/SISU; some international selection routes exist. Teaching is in Portuguese, so proficiency (e.g. Celpe-Bras) is expected.
universidade-de-sao-paulo-br.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

universitas-indonesia.about:
Universitas Indonesia traces its roots to 1849 and has its main campus in Depok and a medical campus in Salemba, central Jakarta. It is Indonesia's leading university for medicine, economics and business, law, engineering, public health and the social sciences.

International students can apply to English-taught International Undergraduate Programs or to Indonesian-taught programmes, with selection based on school records, tests and interviews.
universitas-indonesia.aid_intl: Some scholarships for international students (e.g. Indonesian government KNB scholarship).
universitas-indonesia.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; international applicants are selected on school records and UI's admission tests/interviews. English-taught International Undergraduate Programs require TOEFL/IELTS; Indonesian-taught programmes require Indonesian proficiency. Minimum scores could not be verified.
universitas-indonesia.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

universitat-de-barcelona.about:
Founded in 1450, the University of Barcelona is a large public university with faculties across the city, including the historic building on Plaça Universitat and the Diagonal campus. It is strong in medicine, biology, pharmacy, psychology, economics and business, and the humanities.

International applicants must obtain Spanish university-access recognition (often via UNEDasiss) and then pre-enrol through Catalonia's central system. Public fees are moderate, and most bachelor's degrees are taught in Catalan or Spanish.
universitat-de-barcelona.aid_intl: Spanish/Catalan public grants (mostly for residents) and some UB scholarships.
universitat-de-barcelona.tests: No SAT/ACT. International applicants need their school-leaving qualification recognised for Spanish university access (e.g. UNEDasiss accreditation, sometimes with PCE specific-competence exams for admission grades) and then apply via Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Most teaching is in Catalan or Spanish.
universitat-de-barcelona.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Secondary school diploma with recognition/homologation or UNEDasiss accreditation
Spanish university-entrance route (UNEDasiss accreditation / PCE specific-competence exams) where required
Proof of funds for the Spanish student visa

universite-catholique-de-louvain-uclouva.about:
UCLouvain traces its origins to 1425 and, after the 1968 split of Leuven's university, built the purpose-designed town of Louvain-la-Neuve; it also has campuses in Brussels (Woluwe, medicine), Mons and Tournai. It is strong in engineering, economics and management (LSM), medicine, philosophy, theology and political science.

International applicants need an equivalence for their diploma and French proficiency; medicine requires the Belgian entrance exam and engineering a mathematics admission test.
universite-catholique-de-louvain-uclouva.aid_intl: Limited bachelor's-level aid for international students; reduced fees for students from certain developing countries.
universite-catholique-de-louvain-uclouva.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mainly in French (some bilingual French/English), so French proficiency is required; foreign diplomas need equivalence from the French Community of Belgium. Medicine and dentistry require an entrance exam, and civil engineering a maths admission exam.
universite-catholique-de-louvain-uclouva.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Diploma equivalence from the French Community of Belgium
Entrance exam for medicine/dentistry; maths exam for engineering
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

university-of-otago.about:
Founded in 1869, the University of Otago is a residential university with a historic campus in Dunedin and health sciences campuses in Christchurch and Wellington. It is renowned for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and physiotherapy, and also strong in sciences, law, commerce and humanities.

International students apply directly online with their school results and English evidence; many start with Health Sciences First Year in the hope of entering professional programmes.
university-of-otago.aid_intl: International merit scholarships (partial tuition) for high-achieving undergraduates.
university-of-otago.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent) required for non-native speakers. Health Sciences First Year leads to competitive professional programmes (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy); entry to medicine also involves UCAT ANZ for most applicants.
university-of-otago.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: English test at the programme's level
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa
